<expire>   A paved street of interlocking stone slabs. Hundreds of seagulls
patrol the streets of the Havens, squawking incessantly.
The sky is black and the stars shine down brightly.
The sky is brilliantly clear.
    The only obvious exits are <x>east</x>, <x>northwest</x>, <x>west</x> and <x>southwest</x>.
